name: @devasign/verify
description: Runs DevAsign's generated acceptance tests inside your CI and reports per-criterion evidence.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --external:tsx --external:@playwright/test --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
